It also clarifies that long diagonals are allowed ("Queens separated by more than one row MAY share a long diagonal"). So, it's not the standard N-Queens problem where *any* two queens on a diagonal attack each other. It's a "no-touching" constraint (like placing kings so they don't attack), plus the regional constraint.
